document.heading: ### 9.119 CWC-B：閉じたfamilyの構造／長さと実codec bytesの限定実証

cases.title: CWB01: compiles only the fourteen closed canonical domains within logical workspace caps
CWB02: all commands match the independent codec including unsigned preimages and signed envelopes
CWB03: real Ed25519 owner and auth signatures match without a second signature in composition
CWB04: broker origin and maximum ASCII identifiers match the independent codec
CWB05: four workload shapes preserve every command bound and exact wire/work estimate
CWB06: planning proof makes no calls to reference owner/auth/result materialization
CWB07: insertion order is normalized for nested input keys and noncanonical generated bytes are rejected
CWB08: same-length changed bytes and decoded-only equality cannot pass the oracle
CWB09: request/reply, command/intent and auth unsigned/signed domains cannot be exchanged
CWB10: unknown family, fields and missing required fields fail closed
CWB11: getters, toJSON, custom prototypes and cycles are refused without evaluating suppliers
CWB12: quote, slash, Unicode and surrogate identifiers are unsupported rather than reencoded
CWB13: base64 width formula covers zero and all modulo-three and maximum boundaries
CWB14: actual part bytes match at every modulo-three and maximum valid size
CWB15: noncanonical signature padding and base64 tail bits are rejected
CWB16: auth sequence and TTL digit widths match at all allowed boundaries
CWB17: out-of-range sequence, TTL, unsafe integers and negative zero cannot obtain a proof
CWB18: nineteen command ordinals and count widths retain the unchanged conservative plan bound
CWB19: invalid wireIntent, operation, range order and inventory cannot hide behind a structural proof
CWB20: full context identity and key binding rejects same-length substitutions
CWB21: signed result content changes cannot be passed as an unchecked length receipt
CWB22: proof identity and private context are not transferable to another codec root or command
CWB23: input and returned Buffer mutations cannot change future bytes or proof widths
CWB24: owner close, cancellation and original deadline invalidate receipts without extending time
CWB25: insufficient workspace, fragments and compile work refuse before context getters
CWB26: failed semantic checks keep work consumed and prevent repeated proof execution
CWB27: insufficient proof budget prevents command evaluation and preserves earlier work
CWB28: post-encode expiry and swallowed reentry cannot return a successful buffer
CWB29: actual session owner/auth bytes match without changing runtime frames or dispatch counts
CWB30: a length proof never claims content, signing, approval or production adoption
CWB31: recorded matrix counts are derived from every executed command and domain
CWB32: an oracle mismatch closes the diagnostic family and invalidates earlier receipts
CWB33: epoch and generation decimal widths match through the largest safe integer
CWB34: hash width, alphabet and unsupported auth kinds cannot use an existing layout
CWB35: length-only proof does not bypass full receiver checks for rehashed content or missing parts
